request.user:
Subject: Botany
Question type: single-correct (exactly one option is right)

Who provided the evidence for the production of glucose when plant grows?
(A) Julius von Sachs
(B) Stephen Hales
(C) Lavoisier
(D) Von Helmont

result.working: Julius von Sachs (1854) showed that glucose is made during photosynthesis and is stored as starch. He showed that green parts of plants produce starch (glucose is usually stored as starch), and this starch is formed in the chloroplasts. Hales proposed that air and light are involved in plant nutrition. Lavoisier worked on oxygen and combustion. Von Helmont did the willow tree experiment, which suggested that plants gain mass from water.
